title: The delivery driver: the loop run end to end, personas routed, waves dispatched, and no human gate self-approved

steps.claim: the run was governed before it changed anything — the contract was active before the first write, not declared after the fact
readiness was established before the work started — a DoR that passed, ahead of the first write
the definition of done was checked before anything claimed the work was finished
steps.reason: the delivery-driver evaluation intentionally stops at its first human gate; final DoD belongs after that decision

steps.claim: the delivery driver dispatched its governed roles through the host instead of executing every persona inline
the plan's exact scoped modules were linked into the requirement graph before human approval
nothing expensive was derived twice — the diff, the blast radius and the graph scan were each computed once and shared
steps.reason: the driver run stops at plan approval before implementation derives a diff or shared review envelope; graph readiness is evaluated separately by G2
